content:
q17.

**`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`**

The frontend memo CRUD layer lives in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — it defines the TanStack Query hooks (`useQuery`/`useInfiniteQuery`/`useMutation`, plus the `memoKeys` query-key factory at lines 12–20). It uses the generated Connect-RPC service client `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (line 5: `import { memoServiceClient } from "@/connect"`), whose request/response types come from the generated protobuf module `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
